text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Mmm. It's really not going well, huh?
My timing on the step-in
was off again just now, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe?
Felt kinda like... a frantic scramble, I guess."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Felt so rushed...
My start didn't go as pictured either, so maybe today's just an off day."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So with that, here's hoping for tomorrow. That's a wrap!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That was a crazy fast pivot. Hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's fine by me, 'cause I wouldn't stick around
if she told me we were 'doing this until we get it right~' anyway."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Time to send a report email to Trainer-chan.
Independent training is done~...
The footwork, and also the start was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
…………
"Keep going until you can do it," huh?
...Yeah, maybe that's how I used to be?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“Lately, though... I haven't really had that happen~.
Why is that—”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?!
Trainy, you replied so fast!

"Don't worry! Transcend, just run
and enjoy yourself to the fullest.
Leave the rest to me!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That was figured out pretty easily.
I see, so it was Trainy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Thankies, Trainey-poo.
I'll gladly take you up on that offer~
